answers.title: Airport rail link passes one million riders | TransitWire
answers.text:
Airport rail link passes one million riders

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-23T05:30:00Z

The Harborview airport rail link carried its one millionth rider on Sunday, 11 weeks after the line opened on September 6, the Harborview Regional Transit Authority said.

Trains run every 10 minutes from 5 a.m. to midnight, and the trip from Central Station to the terminal takes 19 minutes.

"We planned for one million riders in the first six months, not the first three," said Tomas Ferreira, the authority's head of service planning.

The authority says weekday ridership averages 13,400, and that it will add two trains to the line in March.

answers.title: Night bus N9 to run every 15 minutes from January | TransitWire
answers.text:
Night bus N9 to run every 15 minutes from January

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-22T07:30:00Z

From January 12, the N9 night bus will run every 15 minutes instead of every 30, the Harborview Regional Transit Authority said on Saturday.

The N9 carried an average of 4,000 riders a night in October, more than any other night route, the authority said.

"Night workers asked for this more than anything else," said Lena Okafor, who chairs the authority's rider panel.

answers.title: Line 4 extension opens two stations | TransitWire
answers.text:
Line 4 extension opens two stations

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-21T16:00:00Z

The Line 4 extension opened on Saturday with 3.2 km of new track and two new stations, Elm Yard and Quarry Lane.

The authority expects 18,500 riders a day on the new section once a full timetable runs in December.

"This is the first new track Line 4 has had in 22 years," said Priya Halden, the authority's chief engineer.

answers.title: Harbor ferry fares frozen for 2027 | TransitWire
answers.text:
Harbor ferry fares frozen for 2027

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-21T14:00:00Z

Harbor ferry fares will not rise in 2027 after the city council voted 9 to 2 on Friday to keep the single fare at $3.40 and the monthly pass at $96.

"Fares were frozen because ridership is still below 2019," said councillor Marco Vidal, who chairs the transport committee.

answers.title: Cityspoke adds 600 e-bikes | TransitWire
answers.text:
Cityspoke adds 600 e-bikes

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-21T11:00:00Z

Cityspoke, Harborview's bike share, added 600 e-bikes this week, bringing its fleet to 2,400, and opened 40 new docks.

answers.title: Rail workers set strike vote for December 4 | TransitWire
answers.text:
Rail workers set strike vote for December 4

TransitWire staff · 2026-11-20T17:00:00Z

About 3,100 regional rail workers will vote on December 4 on whether to strike over pay, their union, the Harborview Rail Workers' Union, said on Friday.

The result is due on December 6. "No one wants a strike before the holidays, but our offer has been on the table since June," said union secretary Ada Brennan.

The authority said talks would continue on Monday.
